identity.name: MLflow
identity.one_liner: Open-source AI engineering platform for experiments, evaluations, observability, and model management.
identity.short_description: MLflow is an open-source AI engineering platform for tracking experiments, evaluating agents and LLM apps, managing models, and monitoring production systems. It is increasingly relevant to teams moving agents from prototypes into production.

positioning.why_it_matters: Agent teams need more than a framework: they need traces, evaluations, model governance, and repeatable deployment practices. MLflow brings mature AI engineering workflows into the agent stack.
best_for: Teams operationalizing LLM and agent applications
ML engineering teams that need experiment tracking and model registry workflows
Developers comparing evaluation and observability layers
not_for: Solo users who only need a lightweight prompt test file
Teams looking for an agent framework rather than an engineering platform

seo.title: MLflow: Open-Source AI Engineering Platform for Agents and LLM Apps

core_strengths.title: Experiment tracking
core_strengths.description: MLflow tracks parameters, metrics, artifacts, and runs across experiments.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Agent teams need to compare prompts, models, tools, and datasets over time.

core_strengths.title: Evaluation workflows
core_strengths.description: MLflow supports evaluation workflows for ML, LLM, and agent applications.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Repeatable evaluation is the difference between a promising demo and a maintainable product.

core_strengths.title: Production AI platform
core_strengths.description: The platform includes model management and operational workflows.
core_strengths.why_it_matters: Teams can connect agent experimentation to the broader AI engineering lifecycle.

use_case_notes.title: Agent evaluation
use_case_notes.description: Track task success, latency, cost, and quality across agent versions.

use_case_notes.title: Prompt and model experiments
use_case_notes.description: Compare prompts, model providers, and parameters under one experiment history.

use_case_notes.title: Production monitoring
use_case_notes.description: Connect development metrics to production behavior and regression checks.

compare_notes.title: When to choose MLflow
compare_notes.summary: Compare it with nearby tools by looking at hosting model, integration surface, license, and whether the official docs show the workflow you need.

seo_article.intro: MLflow is an open-source AI engineering platform increasingly relevant for LLM and agent applications.
seo_article.what_it_is: It provides experiment tracking, evaluation, model management, and operational workflows.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Production agents require disciplined measurement. MLflow gives teams a platform for comparing and monitoring changes.
seo_article.how_it_works: Start by tracking one agent workflow as an experiment, then add evaluation datasets and production monitoring once the workflow stabilizes.

faq.question: Is MLflow open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The repository is listed under the Apache-2.0 license.

faq.question: Is MLflow an agent framework?
faq.answer: No. It is better understood as an AI engineering platform that can support agent development and operations.
